LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Silt.label: irrigated silt
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Silt.description: Black river silt spread over soil and laced with small canals. Plants grow on it as on rich soil, a little less. It can only be laid on soil.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_LotusTiles.label: lotus tiles
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_LotusTiles.description: Sandstone slabs painted with blue lotus flowers and a border of reeds.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Sandstone.label: sandstone slabs
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Sandstone.description: Golden sandstone cut into even slabs by the royal masons. Temples, courts and tombs of Kemet are floored with it.
